summary: The page only addresses AI on the publisher side: Cambridge may use in-house or third-party tools, including AI, to process manuscripts, and such tools will not train on submission data. Where AI is used in the editorial process, a human makes the editorial decisions. The page says nothing about authors' or reviewers' use of generative AI.

evidence.quote: Where AI and other tools are used in the editorial process between submission and acceptance, editorial decisions will be made by a human
